title: Existing helper exact mapped higher-only grade entry

dependency_checks: Resolve private references and verify exact school identity, tested capability, current authority and sole active owner before dependent work.
Acquire the shared browser/source lease including external sessions; a declared concurrency key or missing receipt is not proof that another writer is idle.
Read current authoritative sources and compare relevant revisions immediately before each mutation; stop that mutation on changed, partial or unavailable evidence.
Keep private records and raw evidence outside Git; a configured task, schema validation or open tab never establishes completed execution.
Only the existing registered Chrome helper may write IC grades; a catalog entry or Codex dispatch does not grant another writer.
Freeze exact source revisions and IC school-year, section, term, assignment, component and ten-point binding; recheck before writing and stop if changed.
Require complete current assignment membership, verified identity and source eligibility; keep Study Hall outside grading.
Fill eligible blanks or raise lower scores only; preserve higher grades, Exempt flags, comments and history.
Count meaningful usable received Notes/Concept Bank and Revision separately with coded blanks in denominators; zero denominator is N/A, never zero.
Missing codes/scores or unfinished readable matched work alone do not hold grades; source access, identity, wrong lesson and ambiguous response remain separate safeguards.
Apply the exact registered Photosynthesis repair-first exception and current exclusions; wait on verified empty intake without inventing a missing-work zero.
Any uncertain save/readback stops all further helper writes; no automatic retry, block clearing or new approval popup.

success_checks: Exact destination cells were saved, reloaded and read back against frozen source revisions and assignment bindings.
Per class, section, assignment and component: distinguish entered, raised, kept, left, unattempted and unconfirmed results with receipt evidence.
An unresolved receipt has one exact recovery scope and next step; no verified save prompts the teacher to save again.
